arena_name: Case 3: Azure AD Intrusion SOC Investigation
mission_prompt: Investigate the Azure AD intrusion in D:\Security-logs-test\attack-cases-benchmark\case-3-identity-takeover-impossible-travel\raw-logs. Reconstruct the full attack kill chain across authentication logs, process executions, and network flows. Extract all C2 indicators of compromise (IOCs), map MITRE ATT&CK techniques, and generate automated containment policies.

units.description: Read all files under the specified directory, parse authentication logs (e.g., Azure AD sign‑in events), process execution logs, and network flow logs. Convert each into a structured tabular format (CSV or Pandas DataFrame) with consistent timestamp, source/destination, event type, and relevant metadata.

Using the structured datasets, perform temporal correlation to map the sequence of events from initial compromise (e.g., phishing or credential theft) through lateral movement and persistence. Identify key stages such as Initial Access, Execution, Persistence, Privilege Escalation, Defense Evasion, Credential Access, Discovery, Lateral Movement, Collection, Command & Control, Exfiltration.

units.task_name: Extract C2 IOCs & Map ATT&CK Techniques
units.description: From the kill‑chain analysis, pull out all indicators of compromise such as IP addresses, domain names, file hashes, registry keys, and command strings. For each IOC, map it to the corresponding MITRE ATT&CK technique(s) using available mapping resources or heuristics.

Based on the identified IOCs and mapped ATT&CK techniques, produce a set of containment actions suitable for Azure AD and associated infrastructure. This includes firewall rules, conditional access policies, device isolation commands, and alerting configurations. Output should be in a machine‑readable format (e.g., JSON or PowerShell scripts) ready to deploy.
